rules.action: Intravascular imaging (IVUS or OCT) is recommended for complex PCI. Pre-stent imaging guides sizing and preparation; post-stent imaging confirms expansion and identifies edge dissection. Reduces TVF and MACE (RENOVATE-COMPLEX-PCI, OCTOBER, ILUMIEN IV).
IVUS mandatory for LM PCI. Post-dilate with NC balloon if MSA targets unmet. IVUS preferred over OCT for LM due to better ostial visualisation and no need for contrast flushing in large vessels.
IVUS MSA targets for LM: proximal LM ≥8mm²; distal LM/polygon of confluence ≥7mm²; LAD ostium ≥6mm²; LCx ostium ≥5mm². Post-dilate with NC balloon if any target unmet.

IVUS mandatory pre- and post-stenting for LM bifurcation. Confirm SB ostial coverage, adequate MV expansion, and absence of carina shift. 3-run imaging protocol: pre-stent (both branches), post-POT, and final.
IVUS or OCT strongly recommended for proximal LAD PCI. OCT acceptable where detailed plaque characterisation (calcium depth, lipid pool, thin-cap fibroatheroma) is needed.
IVUS recommended — confirms accurate landing zone, prevents stent protrusion into parent vessel, guides post-dilatation with ostial balloon flaring.

Post-stent imaging recommended: confirm SB ostial coverage, MV expansion, absence of proximal edge dissection, and correct wire position (abluminal rewiring → 23% MACE if untreated). IVUS preferred for LM; OCT acceptable elsewhere.

Intravascular imaging mandatory before AND after calcium modification. Pre-stent: assess calcium depth, thickness, and arc to select modification device (OCT calcium score ≥4 → aggressive modification). Post-stent: confirm adequate expansion (MSA >80% of reference).

Intravascular imaging recommended to characterise calcium depth and circumference. OCT calcium thickness <0.5mm suggests calcium fracture achievable with scoring/cutting balloon alone. Thickness >0.5mm or arc >180° → consider IVL or atherectomy.

Post-stent optimisation targets (non-LM): MSA >5.5mm² by IVUS (>4.5mm² by OCT); relative expansion >80% of average reference lumen area. Correct edge dissection if arc >60°, length >2mm, and depth to media/adventitia.
IVUS mandatory pre- and post-stenting. No compromises on stent optimisation — MSA and edge dissection assessment are non-negotiable when there is no bailout vessel.
Imaging most useful for confirming stent expansion in large grafts. Not mandated for all SVG PCI but consider when stent sizing is uncertain or result suboptimal.
Intravascular imaging recommended for all vessels undergoing PCI in multivessel disease with reduced EF. Optimise every stented segment to reduce target-vessel failure risk.
